title: Client Onboarding Slowdown
context: New private-market client onboarding took 6+ weeks due to manual document collection and compliance checks. Documents were collected in scattered folders, email chains, and vendor portals.
outcome: Implemented automated document verification and pre-checked KYC templates, reducing onboarding from 5 days to 2 days.
lessons: Do not batch KYC checks - they take longer per document when parallelized. Early compliance check reduces rework. Centralize documents in a single source of truth.
checklist: Collect KYC documents in a single standardized intake form
Run automated document verification before compliance review
Pre-check KYC templates to identify missing documents early
Use a single source of truth for all client documents
do: Early compliance review before contract drafting
avoid: Batch KYC checks (they slow down per document)
Manual document collection without a central template
Waiting until the end to run compliance checks
template: Client Onboarding Template: [Document types] [Verification steps] [Timeline targets] [Compliance checkpoints]
best_practice: Automate document collection before compliance review; use pre-checked KYC templates
common_pitfall: Batching KYC documents slows verification; early compliance check reduces rework

title: Contract Review Bottleneck
context: 150+ contracts processed monthly. Legal team did manual clause review; ~3 ambiguous terms per 100. Review took 3+ days per batch.
outcome: Legal spent 20% of time on review. Improved with clause checklists; reduced review time by 60%.
lessons: Regularly update the clause database - new regulations require database updates every quarter. Always have human lawyers review automated extractions.
checklist: Use a clause detection database updated quarterly
Flag ambiguous terms automatically during drafting
Cross-verify with external regulatory requirements
Have a human lawyer review automated extractions
avoid: Waiting until contract is complete to review
template: Contract review checklist: [Clause types] [Ambiguity flags] [Regulatory cross-checks] [Timeline estimate]
best_practice: Build a standard clause library; flag ambiguous terms early
common_pitfall: Manual review misses ~3 ambiguous terms per 100 contracts

title: Data Migration Legacy System
context: Migrated 5 years of client records to a new DB. 12% of records had mismatched fields. Required manual validation.
outcome: Required manual validation. Identified need for automated data profiling and schema mapping.
lessons: Always run parallel loads and compare hashes before decommissioning legacy systems.
checklist: Run validation scripts before migration
Compare hashes between old and new systems
Document schema mapping before migration
Run parallel loads during migration
template: Data migration checklist: [Schema mapping] [Hash comparison] [Validation results] [Go/No-Go decision]
best_practice: Validate at the boundary; compare hashes before decommissioning legacy systems
common_pitfall: 12% of records had mismatched fields without automated validation

title: Client Escalation - Missed Deadline
context: Client escalated after a 3-week delay in a digitization project. Root cause: unmapped task dependencies across teams.
outcome: Implemented dependency tracking; reduced delay incidents by 40%.
lessons: Map task dependencies; flag blockers early; communicate proactively.
checklist: Map all task dependencies before starting
Flag blockers 3 days before deadline
Communicate delays proactively to clients
Document decision ownership at handoff
avoid: Waiting until the day before deadline to warn
template: Escalation early-warning checklist: [Task dependencies] [Blockers] [Deadline timeline] [Client notification template]
best_practice: Proactive communication after a delay prevents client escalation - notify before they ask
common_pitfall: Reactive communication after a delay leads to client escalation and lost trust

title: Quote Estimation Inaccuracy
context: Sales quotes were 20-40% off actual effort. Team relied on intuition without a standard estimation process.
outcome: Created a basic estimation template; reduced error to 10%.
lessons: Break quotes into components; compare estimate vs actual over time.
checklist: Break quote into components (labor, tools, timeline, risk buffer)
Track estimate vs actual for every quote
Update estimation template with actuals after each project
template: Quote estimation template: [Labor] [Tools] [Timeline] [Risk buffer] [Final quote] [Estimate vs actual]
best_practice: Break quotes into components; compare estimate vs actual over time
common_pitfall: 20-40% off actual effort due to intuition-based estimation

title: Squad Rebalancing Under Rush
context: Peak load: 3 engineers dropped off. Manual reallocation caused 2 people to be overloaded. Silent overload went unnoticed.
outcome: Built a simple workload tracker; prevented silent overload in follow-up periods.
lessons: Track availability and skill sets; use constraint-aware assignment.
checklist: Track availability and skill sets before assignment
Use constraint-aware assignment (not just simple allocation)
Update workload tracker after each sprint
Alert when 2+ people are at capacity
best_practice: Track availability and skill sets; use constraint-aware assignment
common_pitfall: Manual reallocation causes silent overload; 2 people overloaded during peak

title: Duplicate Report Generation
context: 3 analysts independently produced similar status reports for the same client. No shared template existed.
outcome: Created a shared template + search index; reduced duplicate work by 50%.
lessons: Centralize templates; enable quick lookup of past work.
checklist: Create a shared template repository
Add search index to find past reports quickly
Enforce template usage for client reports
avoid: No search index for past work
template: Report template: [Header] [Client info] [Status] [Key metrics] [Next steps] [Archive path]
best_practice: Centralize templates; enable quick lookup of past work
common_pitfall: 3 analysts produced similar reports independently, wasting 50% of report time

title: API Integration Failure
context: Third-party market data API failed silently, causing 20% missing data in client reports. No monitoring or fallback.
outcome: Added schema validation + retry/fallback logic; improved reliability.
lessons: Validate at the boundary; implement monitoring and fallbacks.
checklist: Add schema validation at API boundary
Implement retry logic with fallback data source
Add monitoring and alerting for failures
template: API integration checklist: [Schema] [Retry logic] [Fallback source] [Monitoring] [Alert thresholds]
best_practice: Validate at the boundary; implement monitoring and fallbacks
common_pitfall: Silent API failures caused 20% missing data in client reports

title: Vendor Handoff Chaos
context: Handoff of active projects to a vendor lacked documentation. Work took 3 days to resume after the handoff.
outcome: Created a standardized handoff template + access guide.
lessons: Document decisions, ownership, and next steps explicitly.
checklist: Document all decisions at handoff
State ownership clearly
List next steps explicitly
Provide access guide for vendor
best_practice: Document decisions, ownership, and next steps explicitly
common_pitfall: Vendor handoff without documentation caused 3 days to resume work
